title: Ondo two-tone heading
description: The site's section heading: a small medium-weight label above, then a tightly tracked heading whose first line is ink and second line a mid-grey, at 40px on phones and 60px on desktop (or a 20/30px size). Fades up 40px as it enters view.
notes: the reveal is a CSS scroll-driven animation: browsers without it show the heading in place
